hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}"
ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}" S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Missing required command: $1" >&2; exit 2; }; } need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat
cleanup() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN || true rm -f assume-role-output.json inputs.csv Managed_Inputs.csv || true } trap cleanup EXIT
# Assume role (JSON -> env) aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > assume-role-output.json
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' assume-role-output.json)"
# Download managed inputs aws s3 cp "$managed_inputs" ./Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress
# Extract only needed columns csvcut -c \ "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" \ Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
# Validate inputs.csv exists and non-empty [[ -s inputs.csv ]] || { echo "inputs.csv not created or empty" >&2; exit 1; }
# Iterate rows safely (skip header, normalize CSV) tail -n +2 inputs.csv \ | csvformat -U 1 \ | while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do # Trim surrounding quotes/spaces for v in abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do eval "$v=\"\${$v#\\\"}\"" eval "$v=\"\${$v%\\\"}\"" eval "$v=\"\$(printf '%s' \"\${$v}\" | sed 's/^ *//; s/ *$//')\"" done
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" == "yes" ]] && [[ "${data_processed,,}" == "no" ]]; then case "${stdy_type,,}" in topmed|parent|substudy) if [[ "${has_multi,,}" == "yes" ]]; then echo "Deleting existing metadata for ${stdy_id} (multi=yes, type=${stdy_type})" aws s3 rm "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/${stdy_id}/metadata/" --recursive --only-show-errors fi ;; esac fi done
